title: Scoping JEAP, 2024-2026
text:
This is a space to record progress in a scoping review I am working on as a way to better make sense of what kinds of research have been published in the Journal of EAP (JEAP). I am conducting this review partly because of the need to publish as an aspect of my doctoral studies. That is, a review of JEAP published articles makes sense for a doctoral student attempting to become a member of this practitioner community by contributing to the research pool. Simply doing so might provide direction and inspiration for my next project.
One inspiration for the project work is the article “The contexts, theoretical and methodological orientation of EAP research: Evidence from empirical articles published in the Journal of English for Academic Purposes” (Riazi et al., 2020). I notice, however, that the focus on ‘the empirical’ leaves other forms of content uncounted.
Secondly, having recently completed a Reflexive Thematic Analysis project based on methods discussed in Braun & Clarke (2022), I have found myself wondering whether there is a preference for positivist, rather than interpretive, research within articles selected for publication. And, of course, one way to find out what kind of publications are published in JEAP is to conduct my own analysis.

title: About Me
text:
I’m Ben, an Associate Lecturer at UCL focusing on materials development for our CLIE Pre-sessional Course.
I am also a part-time student, which is why I started this page. I am studying at the University of St. Andrews, and through my Doctoral Studies (to become a Doctor of Professional Practice), I have set myself the ambitious goal of completing high quality research studies that are practice focused. That is, I hope to use research projects and methods to improve the quality of the pre-sessional course in terms of teaching and learning, as well as the student and teacher experience.
My main interest is in understanding how students tackle the demands of a pre-sessional research project that involves writing from sources.
